about: The hand saw as the skeleton holds it at the workbench (docs/gameplay/afl_workbench_v1_design.md 17; written by tools/author-hand-saw-actions.mjs). Points, bounds: item block units of the saw mesh as client/AflStaticMeshItemClient draws it (meshes/hand_saw.aflmesh.json + (0.5, -0.27375, 0.5); y along the blade from the handle to the toe, the teeth to -x). Scale 0.508: real size, a 26 inch rip saw, as the bench's pegs hang it. Points: grip the right hand in the handle, kerf the tooth line where it sits in the cut in the middle of a stroke, toe, heel (the tooth line's ends), teeth_mid, hole_c.
